test_unicode_conversion: test unicode string conversion between Python and C++ for UTF-8, UTF-16, UTF-32, and wchar types
test_single_char_arguments: test single character argument casting from Python strings to C++ char, char16, char32, and wchar types
test_integer_casting: test integer casting between Python and C++ for i32, i64, u32, and u64 types with range validation
test_tuple: test bidirectional casting between Python tuples and C++ std::pair and std::tuple types
test_bool_caster: test boolean caster implicit conversions from Python objects with __bool__ or __nonzero__ methods to C++ bool
